Review CapCut?

Reviewers mostly see CapCut as an easy, fast editor for short-form content, especially TikToks, Reels, and quick social posts. They repeatedly praise its beginner-friendly workflow, auto-captions, templates, transitions, effects, and time-saving AI tools, with some saying it is easier to use than heavier alternatives. The main complaints are just as consistent: more features moving behind a Pro paywall, watermarks and weak free limits, glitchy web or cross-device performance, browser restrictions, and a few serious billing and cancellation complaints that hurt trust.
